# Week 1 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-1-ai-fluency.pptx` (51 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_1.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80` → one JPEG per defect/sanity slide
3. Walked the cover, the two flagged content slides, and sampled non-defect content slides for regressions.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_1.py`
- **Cover H1 ran into the gold rule.** "AI Fluency Fundamentals" wrapped to 2 visual lines at 80 pt; the rule was anchored at a fixed offset and sliced through the second line's descenders. **Fix:** added `estimate_visible_lines(text, box_w_in, font_size_pt)` (matching the Week 6 helper, `char_w = 0.62 * pt / 72`); `build_cover` now auto-shrinks the H1 (80 → 72 → 64 → 56 pt) until the title fits in two lines, then sizes the title box from the chosen point size and positions the rule and lede from the resulting box bottom.
- **Two-line content titles overflowed columns.** Slides 15 ("Don't hand it the whole task. Hand it the next step.") and 45 ("The line is uneven. The line moves. Map it for your work.") had `build_content`/`build_two` using a fixed 1.6" title box and a coarse `len // 55` line estimate, so the second line of the H1 collided with the column eyebrows. **Fix:** both builders now call `estimate_visible_lines` against the actual box width and compute `title_h = max(0.85, line_h * lines + 0.20)`; the columns/eyebrows below shift down by the resulting height plus a 0.10" buffer.

## Verified after fix
- Slide 1 (cover): "AI Fluency / Fundamentals" sits cleanly on 2 lines, gold rule below the descenders, lede and meta line below.
- Slide 15 ("Don't hand it the whole task…"): 2-line title sits above the rule; "101 / 201" eyebrows and the two cards are clear of the title.
- Slide 45 ("The line is uneven…"): 2-line title with both AI HANDLES columns positioned below.
- Spot-check slide 30 (quote slide): rendered unchanged, no regression from the helper changes.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_1.py
soffice --headless -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/sof-1 \
  --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week1 docs/pptx/week-1-ai-fluency.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80 /tmp/qa-week1/week-1-ai-fluency.pdf /tmp/qa-week1/slide
```
